original_name: シックスティシックス
source:
A mysterious being that appears before Teru's group.

Calling themself "Nobody 66," this beautiful boy with silver hair is wrapped entirely in white clothes.

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the offical site[/url]]
